desc: Read input $N, X$ and the pairs $(U_i, D_i)$.
Implement the logic to compute $H_{max}$ using prefix/suffix minimums of $(U_i - X \cdot i)$ and $(U_i + X \cdot i)$.
Calculate the minimum cost as $\sum (U_i + D_i) - N \times H_{max}$.
Run the code against sample inputs to verify correctness.
Ensure edge cases (e.g., N=2, large values) are handled correctly by the logic.
Confirm time complexity is O(N) and space complexity is O(N).
Run the code against Sample 1, 2, 3, and 4 to verify correctness.
